messages:
maria: flagging a recurrent problem: validation rejects for fn_call are being charged to customers because downstream billing uses route_id fallback. saw a customer ticket about unexpected overage.
owen: ugh. do we have an example? is route_id actually missing or getting rewritten?
maria: pasted minimal reproducer + log:
```
Client payload: {
  "route_id": "acct-42-prod",
  "model": "redwood/assistant-3",
  "fn_call": {
    "name": "create_order",
    "arguments": {
      "items": null  // schema requires array
    }
  }
}
Validator: WARN [2026-03-14T09:12:11Z] fn_validator: strict_reject schema=order.v1 missing_field items; metadata.route_id=acct-42-prod; routing=fallback-degen
Billing mapper: INFO mapping: route_id=fallback-degen -> plan=internal-dev
```
li: interesting: validator log shows metadata.route_id present but routing step still maps to fallback. looks like routing/mapper only sees post-validated envelope which has degen tag.
nora: so two problems: 1) visibility in Console (operators see degen traffic and assume quota overrun) 2) billing attribution is wrong.
maria: proposal: emit a separate event stream "validation.event" with fields: reject_type, source_route_id, sample_request_id, schema_name. mark these as billing_exempt=true. then update billing mapper to prefer source_route_id if billing_exempt is true. alternative is to add billing_exempt tag to existing invoke.event but i'd rather keep it separate so dashboards don't aggregate it by mistake.
owen: +1 for distinct stream. console-team can surface it as a distinct panel. also avoids touching hot-path invoke.event.
li: gotcha. implementation notes: validator already emits traces to kafka topic "invoke.trace". we can create a low-volume topic "validation.event" and produce compact json. cost: tiny. we need to ensure connectors (partners/proxies) won't drop the source_route_id; add fallback to internal_request_id if route missing.
maria: UX ask: Console should show "Validation rejects (billing-exempt)" with sample request link and reason. Also a note: "These rejects do not consume customer quota." can we do that? @console-team
console-team: yep. we'll add a panel and event inspector. need event key names: `reject_type`, `source_route_id`, `billing_exempt`, `schema` and an example payload for the inspector.
li: also recommend a short-term hotfix: billing mapper should stop mapping fallback-degen to customer plans. Instead mark fallback-degen as internal until we roll this change. That prevents immediate misbilling while we ship the validation stream.
maria: agree. rollback risk? we need a small canary to ensure no regressions in billing pipelines.
owen: rollout plan: 1) add validation.event producer (non-blocking) + sample 5% logs 2) update billing mapper logic to prefer validation.source_route_id when billing_exempt==true, but feature-flagged off 3) canary map enabled in eng-us-east for 2 hours with synthetic invalid fncalls to verify attribution 4) flip flag and backfill dashboards 5) console panel update
nora: add alerting: if validation.event rate > 80/min AND billing attribution to fallback-degen increases -> runbook page and paging to oncall. we should avoid paginating for small minor spikes.
maria: tests: unit tests for producer payload, e2e synthetic script to send 100 invalid payloads and assert billing shows route acct-42-prod. @owen can you own the script?
owen: yep I'll write a script `tools/synthetic_invalid_fncalls.py` and a quick scoreboard check against billing logs.
console-team: one more thing: some customers use our proxy that strips route_id for privacy. for those, we'll surface `source: proxied` and mark billing_exempt=false until we can do reliable mapping. we'll document this caveat in the Console tooltip.
li: good catch. we'll also add a sampling of full-request bodies (scrubbed) to a secure bucket for triage (opt-in via support).
maria: thanks. PR owners: li -> create topic+producer PR, owen -> synthetic script, console-team -> dashboard + tooltip, nora -> runbook + alert. I'll coordinate with billing team to hold immediate refunds till canary verifies.
deploy-bot: queued deploy -> validator:validation-events v0.9 -> eng-us-east at 2026-03-14T12:00:00Z (CI: green)
owen: once canary passes, I'll run the synthetic 100 invalid script and post results here. tagging @billing-bot so refunds team is aware.
billing-bot: noted. will standby for canary confirmation before issuing credits.
maria: thanks everyone. this should stop incorrect chargebacks and make validation behavior transparent in the Console :thumbsup:
